title: Fiction and Metaphysics
version: 1999 author bibliography; publisher chapter metadata also lists 1998
reading_focus: Chapter 3, pp. 35–42; creation, dependence, and identity.
teaching_insight: Fictional characters depend on creative acts and literary practices. The course applies the questions of origin, persistence, and identity to datasets, while distinguishing records from the people and events they represent.
inspection_scope: Whole book downloaded; Chapter 3 dependency account inspected. The analogy does not establish that household bills are fictional or that every data object is an abstract entity.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: Public Artifacts, Intentions and Norms
reading_focus: Intended features and public norms of treatment.
teaching_insight: Public artifacts can involve structural, perceptual, receptive, and normative features. A billing record is designed for a practice whose purposes and recognized uses deserve examination.
inspection_scope: Author manuscript; opening and public-norm discussion inspected. An artifact’s intended purpose does not guarantee accuracy or legitimate every later use.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: Replies to Authors
reading_focus: Manuscript pp. 15–20, especially modal normativism on pp. 19–20.
teaching_insight: Distinguish the function of a discourse from its subject matter and truth conditions. Rules governing modal vocabulary do not imply that modal truths are made true by linguistic conventions.
inspection_scope: Author manuscript downloaded; fiction, fact-talk, and modal-normativism passages inspected. Empirical knowledge remains necessary for many applications of concepts.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: If Models Were Fictions, Then What Would They Be?
reading_focus: Model descriptions, model systems, and the conditional argument.
teaching_insight: Keep the description, the constructed model, and its target distinct. A synthetic billing population can demonstrate a logical possibility without measuring its prevalence in the world.
inspection_scope: Author manuscript downloaded; introduction and distinctions inspected. The conditional exploration does not assert that all models are fictions.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: What Counts as Scientific Data? A Relational Framework
reading_focus: Relational account of data and prospective evidence.
teaching_insight: Whether an object functions as data depends on its role in inquiry and movement across settings. A ledger becomes evidence for a new claim through an evidential argument, with context and provenance retained.
inspection_scope: Full public HTML inspected. PDF endpoint returned a verification page; no local PDF. Leonelli’s account should not be reduced to the claim that every data object is itself a true or false proposition.
reason: Response was not a PDF: text/html
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: Saving the Phenomena
reading_focus: Opening distinction between particular observations and phenomena.
teaching_insight: Reliable patterns are inferred from particular records using substantive reasoning. A stable pattern in aggregate prices and a household burden mechanism are different evidential targets.
inspection_scope: Full paper downloaded; opening distinction inspected. Their data–phenomena distinction is separate from Kant’s phenomena–noumena distinction.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: Introduction to “Raw Data” Is an Oxymoron

teaching_insight: The title provides a useful question: which decisions preceded the supposedly raw file? Use the fully inspected Leonelli readings for the developed account of data practices.

title: Inductive Risk and Values in Science
reading_focus: Consequences of error and direct versus indirect roles for values.
teaching_insight: Consequences of mistaken acceptance or rejection can matter to evidentiary judgment. This supports examining the cost of public reassurance under uncertainty; it does not permit inventing an adverse result.
inspection_scope: Full paper downloaded; inductive-risk argument and values discussion inspected.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: How Values Can Be Good for Science
reading_focus: Critical interaction, pp. 134–135.
teaching_insight: Objectivity requires effective criticism: venues, uptake, public standards, and tempered equality of intellectual authority. Merely permitting comments does little when residents cannot obtain evidence or influence the response.
inspection_scope: Full chapter downloaded; opening and critical-interaction conditions inspected. The electricity application is the course’s argument.
distribution: Source copies remain in Dropbox only; public annotations and original teaching materials are published.

title: The Problem of Undone Science: Values, Interests, and the Selection of Research Programs
reading_focus: Historical formulation of undone science.
teaching_insight: Research agendas can omit questions important to less powerful constituencies. Pair this historical statement with Frickel and colleagues’ later analysis of agenda setting.
inspection_scope: Author copy downloaded; opening and agenda-selection argument inspected. Historical medical examples are outside the course application and are not endorsed.

authors: Catherine D’Ignazio and Lauren F. Klein
title: What Gets Counted Counts
reading_focus: Classification, exclusions, and the power to define categories.
teaching_insight: A schema can impose categories that misrepresent the people recorded. Assess who chose the categories and whose experiences disappear; counting can also support accountability and collective claims.
inspection_scope: Public chapter HTML and opening examples inspected; MIT-hosted 34-page PDF downloaded. PDF states CC BY 4.0.

title: Is Logic a Normative Discipline?
version: Author manuscript saved November 26, 2026; originally presented 2017
reading_focus: Normative principles and the bridge to prescriptions.
teaching_insight: An inference’s logical relation and the prescription governing a reasoner require careful articulation. In the course application, a valid statistical calculation does not supply the moral premise needed for a decision.
inspection_scope: Full author manuscript downloaded; opening argument inspected. The course does not attribute a blanket denial of logical normativity to MacFarlane.

title: Truth

teaching_insight: Compare correspondence, coherence, pragmatist, and deflationary approaches without equating truth with convenience, consensus, or institutional approval. These theories differ; none is established merely by possessing a dataset.
